title: Tenma Saki — Unseen Assistance〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Don't Let Doubts Hold You Back

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho! Over here!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You managed to slip out from your class meeting too, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Today was just schedule planning. I already wrote down when I'll be available and passed it on, so I should be okay.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Great! Next stop: Hona's class!
Class 1-B - Doorway

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I wonder if Hona's gonna be okay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I hope so. As long as she manages to make herself clear to everyone else...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: To be fair, her class isn't the only one that hasn't decided on a song yet, but they definitely do need to act soon.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! And we're here to give her our full support!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Support her by sneakily trying to peep into her classroom...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Didn't you proudly reassure her during lunch that you believed she'd be able to tell them how she really felt or something like that?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm still really worried about her...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho, you slipped out of your class meeting to join us here because you're worried too, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm here because I don't want the person who messaged us about meeting here to lose control of herself and end up making things worse.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, come on! Just admit you're worried about her too!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, okay. Wait, didn't we do something like this before?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you mean when we went to talk to Honami's friends from her class about what happened in junior high?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shh! They're starting their discussion...!
Class 1-B

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: It's not like we'll be making any progress since there are some people who just aren't motivated about it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: How about we vote again? I'm sure most of us just want to get it over with already.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah, just pick something already...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa... This is going south fast...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm... They're totally split down the middle between people that want to give it a try and people that don't...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (You can do this, Hona...!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Everyone, please settle down.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Honami, you can do this...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Give it to them straight!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Phew... She did it...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She did. And I think the rest now understand how she feels too...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Well, this is Honami we're talking about.
I knew this would be a piece of cake for her.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, really? I thought I just heard a certain someone cheer her on by saying, Give it to them straight!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That was, well...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe!

rows.Speaker: Honami's Voice
rows.Line:
Now that we've taken care of that,
I'll go tell the committee what we've chosen.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Saki, Ichika and Shiho?!
What are you doing here?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, haha... No reason♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Well, since our cover's blown...!
You're off to see the committee chairman, right?
We'll walk with you for a bit!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wait, all of you left your own class meetings to come here because you were worried about me?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup. I know it sounds like we're being overbearing but...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You had so much on your plate, it was hard for us to focus on our own class discussions.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I guess we were totally eavesdropping too, huh? Haha... Sorry about that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, it's okay. Thank you, actually.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You were all looking out for me...
I'm grateful for your support.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But you're the one that made it work, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, it was all you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You were so awesome back there!
You told everyone how you really felt, and got them to move in the same direction!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I don't care what anyone else says...
You're amazing and deserve all my respect!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yeah. Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe... But we're still recital rivals, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: No one other than my class is taking home the gold. Not even my precious childhood friend... Right, Ichi?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
That's funny because my class is getting into it too.
This could get interesting.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Alright then, no holding back! Let's make it a serious competition!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Our class is definitely gonna win!
